collection: Cache-only review; no new network requests. Index/robots response examples, status-only blocked receipts and one independently verified USMS public MeetID challenge response. No athlete records or arbitrary query parameters.
limitations: Not a comprehensive WAF inventory or detector; observations are URL/time-specific.
403 alone does not identify WAF/provider; Cloudflare edge headers do not confirm a WAF rule.
Historical denied responses did not retain headers/body; unknowns are not reconstructed.
Manual browser checks are recorded separately from automated HTTP status outcomes and never reset collector cooldowns.
